cap.reason: No llms.txt found. Agents lose primary navigation.

resolutions.llms-txt-exists: Create an llms.txt file at your site root containing an H1 title, a blockquote summary, and markdown links to your key documentation pages. This is the single highest-impact improvement for agent access to your docs.
resolutions.llms-txt-directive-html: No agent-facing directive pointing to llms.txt was detected in the HTML of any tested page. Add a visually-hidden element near the top of each page (e.g., a div with CSS clip-rect) containing a link to your llms.txt. If your site serves markdown versions of pages, mention that in the directive too so agents know to request it.
resolutions.llms-txt-directive-md: No llms.txt directive was detected in the markdown of any tested page. Add a blockquote near the top of each markdown page (e.g., "> For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](/llms.txt)").
resolutions.markdown-url-support: Your pages don't return markdown when .md is appended to the URL. Configure your docs platform to serve .md variants for all documentation pages.
resolutions.content-negotiation: Your server ignores Accept: text/markdown and returns HTML. Some agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode) request markdown this way. Configure your server to honor content negotiation.
resolutions.content-start-position: 1 of 1 pages have documentation content starting 10-50% into the converted output. Reduce navigation, breadcrumb, and sidebar markup that precedes the content area.
